blocks.text: Buying an Executive Home or Acreage Over $1.8M in Maple Ridge

parts.t: Above $1.8 million, Maple Ridge real estate shifts into custom architectural residences on view lots and multi-acre rural estates. Buyers looking for municipal water and sanitary sewer gravitate toward upper Silver Valley, Kanaka Creek border lots in Albion, and executive view subdivisions on the western slopes of Grant Hill in Thornhill.

Buyers seeking privacy, detached workshops, horse barns, or multi-generational living focus on 1-to-10-acre parcels in Websters Corners, Thornhill, Whonnock, Northeast Maple Ridge near Golden Ears Provincial Park, and ALR estates in Northwest Maple Ridge.

blocks.text: Executive Acreage Checks: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, Wells, Septic & ALR

parts.t: When purchasing a $1.8M+ estate in Maple Ridge, due diligence depends on whether the parcel lies inside or outside the Urban Area Boundary. Rural estates in RS-2 (1-acre minimum), RS-3 (2-to-5-acre minimum), or Agricultural Land Reserve (A-1, A-2, A-3) zones require drilled well water potability and flow-rate testing, Authorized Person (ROWPs) septic system inspections, verification of shop/barn building permits, and review of watercourse and steep-slope Development Permit Areas.

What is the Thornhill Urban Reserve and how does it affect $1.8M+ acreages?

Roughly 343 hectares (848 acres) of Thornhill is designated as an Urban Reserve in the Maple Ridge Official Community Plan (OCP Section 10.2.2), requiring a 2.0-hectare (4.9-acre) minimum parcel size until city population exceeds 100,000 and a comprehensive area plan with municipal servicing is adopted.
Can I build a detached shop or coach house on a Maple Ridge acreage?

Accessory building size, height, and detached garden suite rules depend on whether the parcel is zoned RS-2, RS-3, or Agricultural (A-1/A-2/A-3) under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, and whether the land is inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR).
Do $1.8M+ homes in Whonnock and Websters Corners have city water and sewer?

Properties outside the Urban Area Boundary do not have municipal sanitary sewer and use private onsite septic systems. Some parcels in Websters Corners and Thornhill connect to municipal water mains, while Whonnock and upper rural parcels use drilled or shallow private wells.
How does BC Property Transfer Tax work on homes over $1.8M?

In British Columbia, Property Transfer Tax (PTT) is calculated at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion from $200,000 up to $2,000,000, 3% on the portion above $2,000,000, and an additional 2% (total 5%) on the residential value exceeding $3,000,000.
Are development-potential assemblies included in listings over $1.8M?

Yes. Larger parcels inside the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan, Town Centre Area Plan, or Albion Area Plan frequently list above $1.8M based on their multi-family or small-lot subdivision density designation.
